nodes.text:
#endmedicalmafia #HMPV #lockdown 

Beware of the ‘medical mafia’ fueling media panic over HMPV, a common respiratory virus like the flu. Don’t fall for fear-mongering; stay informed with credible sources and avoid sensationalized misinformation.
